description: This file defines internal data structures and functions for managing cache bins in jemalloc, including cache bin statistics, info, and operations for allocation and deallocation.

methods.name: cache_bin_array_descriptor_init
methods.description: Initializes a cache_bin_array_descriptor_t with given small and large bin pointers.

methods.name: cache_bin_alloc_easy
methods.description: Allocates an object from a cache_bin_t, updating its state and success flag.

methods.name: cache_bin_dalloc_easy
methods.description: Deallocates (returns) an object to a cache_bin_t, updating its state.
